correctness.rationale: Each binary input digit and its multiplication-by-three output, together with the final carry, defines an exact bijection to the 3-state weighted paths. This proves the matrix identities for all dyadic lengths. Exact symbolic resolvents and eigenvalues give recurrence, rational GF and oscillatory closed form. A root-of-unity/algebraic-integer contradiction proves angular irrationality; density gives infinitely many large positive/negative values. Exact indicator expansion supplies four disjoint exhaustive joint cells. Finite enumeration to level 17 checks 262143 inputs but is not used to claim infinite validity.

value.rationale: The classical Newman/Coquet single-variable rarefied sum cannot recover conditional dependence between the digit parities of n and 3n. The full joint distribution is a natural arithmetic correlation invariant. Its exact oscillatory smaller spectral term and contrasting growth scales, valid at every dyadic length, refine known marginal bias in a mathematically motivated direction, without an arbitrary cutoff or trivial substitution.
